Q1707507.summary: Eliud Thaddeus Williams is a Dominican politician who served as seventh President of Dominica from 2012 to 2013.

Q5607411.label: 1954 Grenadian general election
Q5607411.desc: General elections in Grenada held on 20 September 1954
Q5607411.summary: General elections were held in Grenada on 20 September 1954. Although independent candidates received the most votes, Eric Gairy's Grenada United Labour Party won six of the eight seats, as it had done in the 1951 elections. At this time the Legislative Council had few powers. The role of head of government remained with the Administrator.

Q4163571.label: 1955 Guatemalan parliamentary election
Q4163571.summary: Parliamentary elections were held in Guatemala on 18 December 1955. The result was a victory for the National Democratic Movement, which won 58 of the 66 seats in Congress.

Q140352499.label: 2026 Venezuela earthquakes
Q140352499.desc: doublet earthquake in norther Venezuela on 24 June 2026
Q140352499.img: LCF-24- MRF Search & Rescue Efforts in Venezuela (9781661).jpg
Q140352499.summary: On 24 June 2026, doublet large strike-slip earthquakes affected northwestern and central Venezuela. The epicenter of the first earthquake was in Veroes Municipality, west of San Felipe, the capital city of Yaracuy. This earthquake, which measured Mw 7.2, occurred at 18:04 VET and was classified as a foreshock.

Q1937395.label: Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party
Q1937395.desc: political party in Minnesota, United States
Q1937395.summary: The Minnesota Democratic–Farmer–Labor Party (DFL) is a political party in the U.S. state of Minnesota affiliated with the national Democratic Party. It was formed by a merger between the Minnesota Democratic Party and the Minnesota Farmer–Labor Party in 1944. The DFL is one of two state Democratic Party affiliates with a different name than the national party, the other being the neighboring North Dakota Democratic–Nonpartisan League Party.
